Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 10), the Planner incorrectly hallucinated the cause of Woody Guthrie's death as "complications of Hodgkin's disease (lymphoma)." This is factually wrong; Woody Guthrie died from complications of Huntington's disease. The Planner failed to verify the specific cause of death on the Britannica page it had successfully loaded in the previous turn, instead relying on an incorrect internal assumption or hallucination when synthesizing the final answer.
